title: Yummy Crispy Malaysian Haddock Stir-fry
description: Savory and crisp, this Malaysian stir-fry features haddock in a tangy, low-carb sauce. It is energizing and diabetic-friendly, perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: Haddock fillets
ingredients.notes: skin removed, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat coconut oil in a wok over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add haddock pieces and sear for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy, then remove and set aside.
In the same wok, stir-fry red bell pepper and snow peas for 2 minutes until slightly tender.
Add green onions and minced garlic, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return haddock to the wok, pour in low-sodium soy sauce and lime juice, tossing to coat evenly.
Sprinkle ground ginger over the stir-fry and stir for another minute, ensuring the sauce thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more lime juice if desired.
Transfer the dish to a serving plate and garnish with a few extra green onion slices.
Serve immediately with a side of cauliflower rice or leafy greens for a complete meal.
